title: Fix ribbon sub-menu z-index cut by ruler
summary: Right-edge ribbon .menu-list triggers anchored left:0 pushed the list past .toolbar's overflow-x clip edge — the sub-menu opened off-screen / was sliced at the ribbon-ruler band boundary. Fix (server repo): setMenu() measures the just-opened list against #toolbar's right edge and adds .flip-right (right-anchored); .menu-list.flip-right .menu-sublist flyouts open left. Pinned live by chrome-probe check (e2).

(b) band background is OO light gray in the light theme
(f) 12 tabs + census Home control count unchanged
(c) 900px: › visible, click shifts content, ‹ appears, clamped at max
(e) 900px: dropdown opens fully visible below the band
(e2) VIS-001: right-edge dropdown flips inside the band (ruler no longer cuts it)
